articles.title: Global Market: Japanese stocks rise as chip rally lifts Topix to record high
articles.content: Japanese equities gained on Thursday, with the Topix hitting a record high and extending its seven-session winning streak. The Nikkei rose 1.6%, led by semiconductor stocks tracking US peers. Strong corporate earnings outlooks also supported sentiment, while financial stocks advanced. Investors remained encouraged by improved profit forecasts across Topix companies.

articles.title: Global Market: SK Hynix, Samsung lead South Korea stocks higher on AI boost
articles.content: South Korean shares surged, with the Kospi rising 3.73% to a three-week high, led by chipmakers SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics. articles.title: Lenskart Solutions shares jump 7% after Q1 results; Jefferies, Goldman Sachs, 3 others raise target price
articles.content: Lenskart shares rose after Q1 FY27 profit surged 182% YoY to Rs 228 crore, while revenue grew 34% and EBITDA jumped 61%. Margins also improved sharply, with product margin crossing 70%. Jefferies, Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs remain positive, citing strong growth, margin expansion and premiumisation, with target prices implying up to 22% upside.

articles.title: Jio Financial shares jump 3% as Bank of America set to acquire 50% stake in Jio Credit for Rs 18,268 crore
articles.content: Jio Financial Services shares: Bank of America agreed to acquire up to 49.9% in its lending arm Jio Credit through a Rs 18,268 crore joint venture deal. The US bank will initially take 26.5%, with the stake potentially rising to 49.9% via warrants, subject to approvals. Jio Credit had an AUM of Rs 30,667 crore as of June 2026.

articles.title: Sensex falls over 200 points, Nifty below 24,350 as expiry volatility looms. What lies ahead?

articles.title: India said to plan easier rules to boost micro-cap listings
articles.content: Sebi is considering sweeping SME IPO reforms to broaden eligibility, boost investor participation and reduce listing costs. Proposed changes include allowing companies valued up to Rs 4,000 crore to list on SME platforms, removing minimum trade sizes, and easing market-making and underwriting requirements. The regulator is expected to issue a consultation paper seeking public comments.

articles.title: HAL shares gain 2% after Q1 earnings beat estimates. Nomura, other brokerages hike target price
articles.content: In the first quarter of FY27, Hindustan Aeronautics showcased a robust 15% rise in net profit, prompting brokerages to adjust their target prices for HAL shares. articles.title: Chandra’s Rs 25 lakh crore Tata legacy: Revenue up 71%, PAT 3.6x and a 19x multibagger
articles.content: N Chandrasekaran has significantly boosted Tata's legacy, achieving a remarkable increase in market capitalization totaling Rs 25 lakh crore.
